title: On Investigating the loss of the winter stores
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：investigate　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 investigate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the fisherman ① investigated the loss of the winter stores at once, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② investigates the loss of the winter stores in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ investigate the loss of the winter stores at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ investigated the loss of the winter stores before — a line in the logbook for July 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Investigating the loss of the winter stores at once, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ investigate the habits of that strange fish in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Investigate the habits of that strange fish at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ investigates the habits of that strange fish at once every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ investigated the loss of the winter stores again when nobody else would.

⑩ To investigate the loss of the winter stores, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody investigates the loss of the winter stores in the rain again and somebody must investigate the loss of the winter stores at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 调查（一般过去式 investigated the loss of the winter stores：1957 年渔人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 调查（一般现在 investigates the loss of the winter stores：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 调查（不定式 to investigate the loss of the winter stores：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 调查（过去完成时 had investigated the loss of the winter stores：1951 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 调查（动名词 investigating the loss of the winter stores 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 研究（investigate the habits of that strange fish：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去研究研究那种少见鱼的习性）
G. v. 研究（investigate the habits of that strange fish：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 调查（后段两处：新来的船工照例 investigates the habits of that strange fish，而母亲又一次 investigated the loss of the winter stores）

answers.why: investigate 意为“调查”，1957 年渔人二话不说地调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 investigated。
investigate 意为“调查”，自那以后渔人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 investigates。
investigate 意为“调查”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的”，此处为不定式 to investigate the loss of the winter stores。
investigate 意为“调查”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人调查过，故用过去完成时 had investigated。
investigate 意为“调查”，渔人说“调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 investigating the loss of the winter stores 作主语。
investigate 意为“研究”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去研究研究那种少见鱼的习性”，should ever 之后用原形 investigate the habits of that strange fish。
investigate 意为“研究”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻研究研究那种少见鱼的习性（investigate the habits of that strange fish at once），以后再也不要提起。
investigate 意为“调查”，新来的船工每个汛期都照例研究研究那种少见鱼的习性，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 investigates。
investigate 意为“调查”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的，用一般过去式 investigated 叙述。
investigate 意为“调查”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，渔人二话不说地调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的；渔港里每一个船工都说这是头一回。（investigated the loss of the winter stores）
多年以后，渔人仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（investigates the loss of the winter stores）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的这件事本身。（to investigate the loss of the winter stores）
早在 1951 年就有人调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的，七月那天航海日志上的一行字就是证据。（had investigated the loss of the winter stores）
渔人说过，二话不说地调查查那批冬储是怎么丢的这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（investigating the loss of the winter stores 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻研究研究那种少见鱼的习性，以后再也不要提起。（investigate the habits of that strange fish，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the fisherman investigated the loss of the winter stores at once, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the fisherman still investigates the loss of the winter stores in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to investigate the loss of the winter stores at all was the part nobody had expected.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 investigate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the fisherman investigated the loss of the winter stores at once, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman investigates the loss of the winter stores in the rain whenever the harbour asks.
Investigating the loss of the winter stores at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever investigate the habits of that strange fish in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour investigates the habits of that strange fish at once every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother investigated the loss of the winter stores again, and the harbour remembered that half.
